description: This Dart source file defines the CodegenProvider class, which manages local form state and generated code output for a code generator feature in a Flutter app. It handles persisting session data using SharedPreferences, outputting stub code snippets based on user input, and exposing an API for external components to interact with the code generation logic.

classes.name: CodegenProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class managing the code generation form state, output, and persistence.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Loads the last session data from SharedPreferences.

methods.name: _save
methods.description: Saves current session data to SharedPreferences asynchronously.

methods.name: setLanguage
methods.description: Sets the target programming language and triggers state update and persistence.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description prompt, updating state and saving it.

methods.name: setDocRef
methods.description: Sets an optional document reference and updates state.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Simulates code generation based on current state; updates the generated code output.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets all fields and output to default state.
